evidence.summary: The bakery wastes about fifteen percent of the bread most days.
evidence.quote: We throw away about fifteen percent of the bread most days.

evidence.summary: Ran out of butter on a Friday and could not make croissants for the weekend.
evidence.quote: Nobody posted that butter was low, we ran out on a Friday and could not make croissants for the whole weekend.

evidence.summary: Uses gut feeling and past sales to decide how much bread to bake.
evidence.quote: Mostly gut feeling. I look at what sold the same day last week and add a little.

evidence.summary: Staff post low stock in a WhatsApp group for end of day ordering.
evidence.quote: My staff post what is running low in a WhatsApp group, and I order at the end of the day.

evidence.summary: Pays nephew 200 GEL a month to maintain the ordering spreadsheet.
evidence.quote: I pay my nephew 200 GEL a month to keep the ordering spreadsheet up to date.

evidence.summary: Agreed to use the beta for two weeks and make two introductions to other bakery owners.
evidence.quote: Send me the beta and I will use it for two weeks, and I will introduce you to two other bakery owners I know.
